_comment: JARVIS 2 MCP server wiring for mcporter (https://mcporter.dev). OpenClaw bridges MCP through mcporter, so this is where JARVIS's 'sub-agents' plug in. Copy the servers you want into your mcporter config (default: ~/.mcporter/config.json), then run `mcporter list` and `mcporter list <server> --schema` to verify. Put secrets in env vars, NOT inline. Only wire what you'll actually use — fewer tools = sharper routing.

gmail._comment: Email sub-agent. Use a hosted Gmail MCP or a local one (e.g. GongRzhe/Gmail-MCP-Server). OAuth per that server's setup.

gcal._comment: Calendar sub-agent. Google Calendar MCP (e.g. nspady/google-calendar-mcp). Needs Google OAuth creds.

gdrive._comment: Knowledge/files sub-agent. Google Drive MCP. Docs read/write + search.

slack._comment: Team comms. Official/community Slack MCP. Needs a bot token + team id.

supabase._comment: Long-term memory + CRM. Supabase MCP (read/write via SQL). Apply jarvis/supabase/schema.sql first. Use a scoped access token.

canva._comment: Designs/graphics. Canva MCP (remote/HTTP). OAuth in your Canva connector.

higgsfield._comment: Image/video/audio/voiceover generation — JARVIS 2's media studio. Remote MCP.

vidiq._comment: YouTube/social growth: keyword research, titles, thumbnails. Remote MCP.

jotform._comment: Forms/intake/surveys. Jotform MCP. Needs an API key.
